Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the conflicting data from WebSurfer and decided to re-enter the loop without refining the search strategy. This decision caused the loop to be entered unnecessarily (violating Rule 1) and perpetuated the ambiguity in the data (violating Rule 2). Although recovery was still possible at this point, this step set the stage for the irrecoverable errors later in the loop.
